source: William Lilly Christian Astrology first edition 1647, Wellcome b30338724
heading: Whether Native will enjoy Estate of Father and whether waste or consume it
scope: Historical paternal inheritance and economic-management claims, not empirical family/probate/financial forecasts.

groups.passage: Printed CXXIIII heading and inherited-estate outcome

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CXXIIII Whether Native will enjoy Estate of his Father
claims.meaning_historical_only: Printed CXXIIII begins below a divider later original PDF606, separate from earlier maternal childbirth section.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: whether he shall waste or consume it
claims.meaning_historical_only: The original differentiates receiving/augmenting paternal estate from dissipating inherited property.

groups.passage: Daytime Sun, Jupiter/Venus and night Saturn/Moon positive estate combinations

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Sun conjoyned to Jupiter or Venus by day
claims.meaning_historical_only: A diurnal birth with Sun joined to Jupiter or Venus is a stated favorable patrimony condition.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn and Moon to the same Planets in nocturnal Nativity
claims.meaning_historical_only: A corresponding nighttime condition invokes Saturn and Moon with those beneficial planets, subject to original operator clarity.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: or in good aspect with them
claims.meaning_historical_only: Good aspects to those benefics are an alternative to conjunction in the source's favorable estate pattern.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: especially in the second or fourth
claims.meaning_historical_only: The author emphasizes second/fourth-house placement in his father-wealth inheritance branch.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: or if they have dominion in fourth
claims.meaning_historical_only: Benefic planets governing fourth house are an alternative source condition, not necessarily requiring placement in that house.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: good Patrimony to descend to the Native
claims.meaning_historical_only: The author asserts an inherited patrimony for the qualified favorable chart, not documented actual estate transfer.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: make good improvement of it
claims.meaning_historical_only: Lilly also claims competent management of the inheritance rather than just receipt of the estate.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: exceedingly augment Paternall Inheritance
claims.meaning_historical_only: An additional substantial increase is alleged, with no measured wealth baseline or counterfactual.

groups.passage: Negative Mars affliction to father planet, sect qualification, absence of beneficial relief

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Mars in like manner afflicting
claims.meaning_historical_only: Mars affliction of the relevant paternal significator is the adverse branch, distinct from inherited wealth support.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: either Sun by day
claims.meaning_historical_only: In daytime births the negative Mars source attaches to the Sun, not Saturn by default.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: or Saturn in a night birth
claims.meaning_historical_only: In nighttime births the author substitutes Saturn for Sun in the Mars affliction clause.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: no benevolent aspect of the Fortunes intervening
claims.meaning_historical_only: The original adverse condition additionally excludes an intervening beneficial aspect as mitigation.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Native will dissipate his Fathers Estate
claims.meaning_historical_only: The author asserts wasteful loss of inherited estate under this group, not a tested financial forecast.

groups.passage: Nocturnal weakened Moon plus malefic and house-ruler conjunction

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon in a nocturnall birth diminished in light
claims.meaning_historical_only: Lilly's next inheritance-loss condition is restricted to nighttime birth and a diminished Moon.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: impedited by Mars or Saturn
claims.meaning_historical_only: Affliction by either Mars/Saturn is additionally required, not a Moon-phase-only forecast.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord of the second in like manner
claims.meaning_historical_only: The second-house ruler must also be unfavorable under the source's cumulative alternative clause.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: or Lord of fourth and that house be afflicted
claims.meaning_historical_only: Another branch allows fourth lord and house affliction as a relevant precondition.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: together with this second house and lord unfortunate
claims.meaning_historical_only: The source further qualifies the adverse wealth judgment with a weak second house and ruler.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Native will waste his Patrimony and bring it to nothing
claims.meaning_historical_only: The author predicts ruin of patrimony, not independent probate or wealth data.

groups.passage: Saturn in twelfth with peregrine fourth ruler

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn in the twelfth
claims.meaning_historical_only: Saturn located in twelfth is one prerequisite for the author's alleged destruction-of-estate branch.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: with the Lord of fourth and both Peregrine
claims.meaning_historical_only: Both Saturn and fourth-house lord being peregrine additionally qualify that branch.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Native consumes the Fathers Estate
claims.meaning_historical_only: This combination is said to predict consumption of inherited resources, with no tested real person.

groups.passage: Malefics in fourth with unfortunate Ascendant ruler

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Infortunes are in the fourth
claims.meaning_historical_only: Adverse planets occupying fourth are an additional purported patrimony-loss configuration.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord of first with them unfortunate
claims.meaning_historical_only: The ascendant ruler sharing or related to them and being unfortunate further qualifies the condition.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: in like manner consumes Fathers Estate
claims.meaning_historical_only: The author assigns the same negative result to this alternative, not independent evidence for loss.

groups.passage: Sun/Mars conjunction, peregrine and second-house affliction

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Sun and Mars in conjunction
claims.meaning_historical_only: A Sun/Mars conjunction is another separate historical source of father-estate loss.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Peregrine
claims.meaning_historical_only: The original requires at least one relevant planet peregrine; exact referent remains uncertain.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: afflicting the second house
claims.meaning_historical_only: The Sun/Mars condition also afflicts the second house rather than guaranteeing harm by its mere presence.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: argue the same
claims.meaning_historical_only: The text concludes the same patrimony-wasting result as earlier branches.

groups.passage: Following printed CXXV parental agreement navigation only

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CXXV Of the mutuall agreement of Parents
claims.meaning_historical_only: Printed CXXV opens on PDF607 after a divider as a separate relational question.

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: In diurnall Genitures consider Sun and Venus
claims.meaning_historical_only: The first phrase of CXXV is retained solely as a boundary witness, not a patrimony rule.
